$comment: Commit SHAs a build of this fixture produces. Format: a JSON object whose 'branches' object maps each branch build.py creates to its head commit SHA. 'main' holds the base commit; 'owner-priya', 'owner-jun' and 'owner-sam' each hold one owner's checkpoint on top of the base. tests/test_fixture_builder.py checks that a fresh build reproduces every SHA.
